ideas.name: Fieldnote
ideas.tagline: Turn customer observations into sharper creative briefs.
ideas.problem: Strategy teams may lose useful customer observations between research and creative briefing.
ideas.solution: A compact workspace linking an observation to a tension, a creative direction and a test.
ideas.whyNow: Test whether greater access to AI research creates demand for better synthesis.
ideas.distribution: Interview five independent strategists through existing professional contacts.
ideas.priceHypothesis: Test £15 per month; willingness to pay is unknown.
ideas.falsificationTest: Ask five strategists to use one real brief; stop if none returns to use it again.
uncertainties: The problem has not been validated with intended users.
Existing alternatives and willingness to pay require research.

pages.headline: Good strategy starts with noticing.
pages.subhead: Keep the observations that matter. Connect them to a clearer brief and a better question.

benefits.title: Keep the useful detail
benefits.body: Give the important detail a place to live, with enough context to use it later.

benefits.title: Find the human tension
benefits.body: Work through one focused question and leave with a clearer direction.

benefits.title: Write a sharper brief
benefits.body: Turn the idea into a small experiment you can actually try.

steps: Bring one real problem you want to work on.
Work through a short, focused first session.
Leave with one useful next action.
